description: LANDSCAPE 640x360 pixel-art BACKGROUND ONLY for a fantasy fitness dungeon encounter, matching the reference game room pixel density and indigo stone palette. A grand ancient stone guardian chamber viewed STRAIGHT INTO THE ROOM at character eye level, never isometric or top-down. One coherent centered single-point perspective: the back wall faces the viewer flat, all vertical columns upright, level horizontal stone courses, stone floor tiles consistently receding to ONE vanishing point. Floor starts near y=218 and fills the lower 142 pixels. Broad empty walkable floor, unobstructed, level footing for characters at y=285. Two sturdy square stone pilasters around a tall recessed sealed arched door in the back wall near x=260, restrained cyan rune inlay on the door, weathered carved blocks, dim amber light softly grazing outer wall edges and cool moonlit blue shadows. Rich but restrained SNES/16-bit RPG pixel art, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, limited palette, no blur, no gradients. The left two thirds are the open encounter stage, with a calm darker wall behind character silhouettes. Keep the right third quiet simple stonework because a separate live workout panel will overlay it. No elevated dais or steps under characters. No characters, monsters, statues, UI, text, frames, HUD, bars, numbers, loose objects, treasure, weapons, gym equipment, boxing ring, benches, beds or furniture. Architecture and floor only. Match the reference visual style, not its exact room contents. Believable room scale, strong depth and readable central silhouettes. Opaque full canvas.

references.usage: Style reference only: pixel density, palette, straight-on level perspective, believable consistent floor tiles. Create a guardian dungeon chamber instead of a home gym.
